description: Activate when: user says 'this person/startup looks like a winner', 'I know one when I see it', 'they have the profile of a great hire', 'this reminds me of [famous success]', or any judgment where a vivid profile drives a probability estimate without an explicit base rate. Also activate when auditing for the conjunction fallacy or when pattern-matching is cited as the basis for a high-stakes decision. Do NOT activate when: probability is computed directly from data with no narrative element; base rate and profile have already been reconciled via explicit Bayesian reasoning. More: deciqai.com/c/representativeness-heuristic
